description: Loading skeleton and error notice for the household-setup screen, matching the calendar redesign's skeleton block + noticeCard conventions.

loading.note: Header renders immediately (static title). Do not show during background refresh.

backgroundRefresh.condition: focus reload with data already present
backgroundRefresh.treatment: ActivityIndicator size=small color=colors.primary2 in header right slot; content stays; no skeleton

error.condition: household fetch failed for a non-404 reason (explicit errored flag)

sub.text: Check your connection and try again.

error.note: A 404 / no-household response is NOT an error — it routes to no-household Mode B, never here.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Skeleton pulse becomes a static colors.glassMedium block when reduce-motion is enabled
